topology: 1 node x4 GPUs, NCCL 2.28+ symmetric window on a non-blocking communicator, the window registered inside a group; case 28's store ring over NVLink
golden: none, by design — every quantity follows from window_bytes and iters
why: On a non-blocking communicator (config.blocking = 0) init, window registration and ncclGroupEnd return ncclInProgress, and NCCL's thread writes the communicator's rank and the window handle after the call has returned; inside a group the handle is still null at return even on a blocking communicator. The provider recorded only what was there at return, so such a run had no nccl_comm, no nccl_window and no peer mappings, and every store through the window was unplaceable (CR-25). Same stores as case 28, so the same placement must come out.
workload_note: `lsa_ring 131072 10 nonblocking`: case 28's workload (its lsa_ring.cu) with ncclCommInitRankConfig(blocking = 0), the window registered between ncclGroupStart and ncclGroupEnd, and ncclCommGetAsyncError polled to ready after init, registration, deregistration and finalize. One communicator and one window per rank; window_bytes/4 * iters = 327,680 peer stores per rank, each owned by rank (r+1) % ranks.
